title: Bloch Sphere Visualizer
creator: EE 5340 Course Team, UMN
subject: Quantum Computing
Quantum Gates
Qubit States
description: Interactive 3D Bloch sphere visualization showing single-qubit quantum states as a unit vector. Users can set the polar angle theta and azimuthal angle phi with sliders, apply X, Y, Z, H, S, and T quantum gates via buttons, and drag to rotate the sphere view. The Dirac-notation state vector and Bloch coordinates are displayed in real time.

learningObjectives: Visualize single-qubit quantum states on the Bloch sphere
Apply X, Y, Z, H, S, T gates and observe geometric rotations
Connect Dirac notation state vectors to Bloch sphere coordinates

controls.label: φ (phi)
controls.description: Azimuthal angle — rotates state around Z axis

controls.label: X
controls.description: Apply Pauli-X gate: π rotation around X axis

controls.label: Y
controls.description: Apply Pauli-Y gate: π rotation around Y axis

controls.label: Z
controls.description: Apply Pauli-Z gate: π rotation around Z axis

controls.label: H
controls.description: Apply Hadamard gate: π rotation around (X+Z)/√2 axis

controls.label: S
controls.description: Apply S (phase) gate: π/2 rotation around Z axis

controls.label: T
controls.description: Apply T gate: π/4 rotation around Z axis

controls.label: Sphere drag
controls.description: Click and drag inside drawing area to rotate the 3D view

equations: x = sin(θ)cos(φ),  y = sin(θ)sin(φ),  z = cos(θ)
assumptions: Pure states only (no mixed states or decoherence)
limitations: Does not model mixed states or density matrices
